title: Review of c30's BFF soup O finding: a fresh seed reproduces the drift-level turnover (Supported)
summary: Labkit re-run of world.py on seed 5 (rerun/seed5): the 32 planted replicators take over the 4096-tape soup by t~75-125 (sheet.png). Seeded 2^15 soup on seed 5 to epoch 14000 with the claim's own seeded.py, functional.py and o_bff.py (s5/): the replicators keep copying exactly (top-5 tapes 100% exact copies in every 1000-epoch window), the commonest tape drifts from the ancestor (Hamming 20 -> 33), and functional diversity jumps later than in the claim (60-117 kinds to 333-474 between epochs 9000 and 11000, against ~8000 in seed 0), with the top-2 share of repeated tapes falling from 0.5-0.6 to 0.04-0.06 and top-20 overlap with the previous window falling to 0.05-0.35. Cohort novelty never exceeds the shadows: real [0,1,0,0,1,0,0,0,0,2,0,0,1,0] vs shadow mean up to 1.62 (g=25) and real all 0 vs shadow mean up to 1.88 (g=50).

observations.finding: s5/o_g25.json and s5/o_g50.json: late-window cohort novelty 0-1 vs shadow means 0.9-1.9; turnover of the commonest functional kinds after the diversity jump (top-20 overlap with previous window 0.05-0.35) with every top-5 tape an exact copier
observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png: the planted replicator fills the soup by t~125

seeds_run.result: pass: labkit re-run reproduces takeover; seeded 2^15 soup to 14000 epochs reproduces exact-copier persistence, a later diversity jump and no cohort excess over shadows

controls_run.finding: census shadows g=25 and g=50, 8 each, re-run on my seed (s5/o_g*.json)

not_checked: spontaneous-soup transition statistics (I did not run the 2^17 spontaneous soups)
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, 14000 epochs (the claim went to 20000), so my post-jump stretch is only 3-4 windows and the counts are small (0-2), which cannot separate real from shadow either way; the finding is a negative for O and my run agrees with it, not more. Two details differ from the summary: o_bff.py takes a* as the 99.9th percentile of the shadow pool (np.percentile(pool, 99.9)), not the 99th the summary states; and on my seed instructions per interaction rise to ~4650 by epoch 10000 and then fall to ~3000 at the diversity jump, rather than rising with it (2500 -> 3300) as on seed 0.
